external_source_adoption.note: No external repository source code was copied, extracted, or merged by M0095. Presentation and visual runtime slots are operator-supplied downstream commands. No external license claim is therefore made.

limitations: The uploaded archive contains no .git metadata, so remote Git provenance of the archive cannot be cryptographically established from the worktree.

The orchestrator binds API/UI/control services to loopback; the one public Studio origin is the nginx gateway. Native external runtimes require operator-provided launch commands and target/health URLs.

External runtime native availability was not proven in this environment. The test sandbox does not provide a native OpenChatCut/presentation/SuperVisual/SAM3 runtime installation, and apps/web node_modules are absent.
Runtime UI compatibility with a non-root path such as /runtime/openchatcut/ is not proven; the downstream runtime must support its configured base path for a true single-tab UI experience.
A focused green suite proves orchestrator behavior only; it does not establish semantic correctness, visual quality, provenance sufficiency, or production release authorization.
